supersedes: SourceAssets/Art/Creatures/Duck (untracked stylised candidate: SK_Duck, SK_Duck_Headless, SM_Duck_Head)
source_blend: Duck/SK_Duck.blend (three collections plus the hidden high-poly DuckHigh)
species_note: All-white domestic (Pekin type) duck with orange bill and feet, as every frame of the sprite shows. The black patches on the earlier contact sheet were a shading defect (inverted normals baked from back-facing feather vanes, plus vertices left behind by dropped skin weights), not a colour choice; both causes are fixed in duck.py.
slot_note: First four keep the candidate names and share T_Duck_Atlas_*. MI_Duck_FeatherCards (masked or dithered, two-sided, NO dynamic shadow; multiply base colour by the mesh vertex colour, which carries a per-feather tint: cream staining, belly soil, slight value jitter) uses T_Duck_FeatherCards_BC (alpha) / _N / _ORM, an 8-cell feather atlas, for about 2,150 cards: contour and down feathers over body and neck, wing coverts, scapulars, secondaries, primaries, tail coverts and rectrices. Cards carry custom vertex normals blended toward the skin normal: import normals, do not recompute. Gore variants: SK_Duck_Headless and SM_Duck_Head swap MI_Duck_Feather for MI_Duck_Feather_Bloody (T_Duck_Atlas_Bloody_BC/ORM, same N), use MI_Duck_FeatherCards_Bloody (T_Duck_FeatherCards_Bloody_*) on the cards round the wound, and add MI_Duck_Gore (T_Duck_Gore_*, two-sided: wound section, torn skin collar, vertebra stub, trachea, oesophagus, vessels).
rig_compatibility: Existing 23-bone armature and all nine actions (Idle, Walk, Run, Peck, Quack, Hit, Death, HeadlessRun, HeadlessDeath, 30 fps) carried over untouched; no bone added or renamed. Mesh rebuilt on 12 Nov 2026 (v2). Body skinned with bone heat; the wing, shin, foot and jaw influences on the plumage are handed to spine_01, pelvis and head; bill, legs, feet, eyes rigid; wing shells and wing cards blend wing -> wingtip; tail cards on tail_01/02; stump parts on neck_02. SK_Duck_Headless shares the armature (import against the SK_Duck skeleton). Verified by rendering Walk f4, Peck f18, Quack f8 and HeadlessRun f4.
importer_notes: One FBX per LOD (Export/<Asset>_LOD0..2.fbx) plus one armature-only FBX per clip, written with the same recipe as the existing creature exporters (metres source, temporary x100 export scene, FBX_SCALE_ALL, Armature wrapper node, no leaf bones). Import each LOD explicitly, as Scripts/import_creature_art.sh does. Normal maps are OpenGL (green up): keep the importer green-channel flip used by the existing creature manifests. ORM = AO/roughness/metallic, linear. SSS map (linear, single channel) is a subsurface weight mask for the creature material; without a subsurface profile the asset still reads, only flatter. SM_Duck_Head is a static prop (three LOD FBXs, no UCX hull authored; a simple sphere collision is enough). The earlier candidate was never imported, so this is a first import. Validator reports UV_OVERLAP because the feather cards (own atlas, own slot) share UV0 space with the body atlas; the body islands do not overlap.

gore.note: Decapitation kept. The neck is bisected and capped with the cross-section texture; on top of the cap sits modelled stump anatomy: a ragged collar of torn skin flaps, the cervical vertebra stub with transverse processes, a ringed open trachea pulled forward, the collapsed oesophagus and hanging clotted vessels (body side). Plumage round the cut is blood-soaked in the baked atlas (texture-space composite from the position map, runs down the breast) and the feather cards near the wound switch to a blood-matted card atlas. The severed head carries the matching short stump.

status: NOT photoreal at 1 m; a believable white farm duck at the game camera and at 2 m. Round 3 (12 Nov): head, eye, bill, mouth, wing shoulder, denser tinted plumage and gore reworked.
fixed_defect: Black patches: (1) the high-poly feather vanes were loose islands whose faces Blender oriented at random, so about half baked inverted tangent normals (black shading wherever the normal map was applied); every vane is now oriented along its skin normal and the baker flips any remaining inverted texel. (2) Dropping the wing/leg/jaw skin weights from the plumage left some vertices on spine_01, which stretched black faces under the head and between the wings in posed frames; the weight is now handed to head/spine_01/pelvis. (3) In the Cycles review, more than 16 overlapping alpha cards hit the transparent-bounce limit and rendered black specks; the review now allows 96 (renderer setting only).
known_weaknesses: Head feathers are still a fine horizontal woolly relief at 0.5 m (very visible on the severed head, which is seen closest); the request for tiny cards or a fur-like normal is not met. Crown is flatter but the head still reads round from three-quarter front.
Eye: iris and pupil read now, but on the severed head the iris is a flat bright orange disc with a hard edge and no eye ring relief.

Blood pool under the severed head: glossy and dark, but its three-lobed outline has straight-looking edges and reads as a cut-out shape at 0.4 m; satellite drops are domed beads. It is flat-ground geometry: on slopes it will float.
Stump: collar now mostly blood-covered with clots, but blood on the neck feathers is still a clean saturated red with scalloped card edges; matting is a texture swap, not clumped feathers.
Breast: denser and lower-lying, fewer petals, but still individually readable grey-shaded cards at 1 m rather than soft down. Cream and soil tint is subtle; the bird is still clean.

Folded wing: shoulder is rounder and the primaries are tucked, yet from the front three-quarter view the leading edge is still a straight vertical line with a dark gap behind it; covert rows are not clearly scalloped.
Bill: colour variation is mild at game distance; no serration relief on the mouth lining; tongue is a simple pad.
Feet: unchanged (knuckled toes, webs with sag); not dirtier than before.

LODs judged by eye at the game camera (final_lods.png): LOD1 holds. LOD2 FAILS on the bill and feet: decimation collapses the bill into a dark crooked spike and darkens the feet; plumage and silhouette hold. LOD2 needs the bill and feet excluded from decimation (not done).

Validator: UV_OVERLAP on all three (cards share UV0 with the atlas, intended); 5 zero-area faces at the headless neck cut. LOD0 17,694 triangles (SK_Duck), 15,413 (headless), 6,260 (head prop with pool).
round3_changes: Head: flatter crown (higher superellipse exponent, lower top), fuller cheeks, eye moved up and back, larger eye with dark lid skin, brown iris and pupil; head feathers lie flat. Bill: pinkish base, darker nail, stains; palate, mouth floor and tongue added (visible in Quack and on the severed head). Wing: rounded shoulder bulge, primaries shortened and tucked. Plumage: 2,800 contour cards (was 1,800) with per-feather vertex-colour tint (cream staining, belly soil, value jitter). Gore: darker flesh, clots, blood rim on the collar, darker blood-matted card atlas, and a 1-5 mm thick pooled-blood mesh with satellite drops under the severed head (UV corner patch of T_Duck_Gore).
